summary: EVAVO's provider-neutral long-form narration, audiobook production and optional illustrated-story companion authority. It owns manuscript integrity, story/pronunciation/performance truth, rights and consent gates, provider capability negotiation, durable generation orchestration, artifact-backed completion, continuity, technical/creative take review, mastering and release-package preparation while keeping external provider output, take approval and final release as separate evidence-bound state transitions.

capabilities.title: Admit immutable manuscripts with complete coverage proof
capabilities.description: Fingerprint manuscript revisions, create deterministic chained integrity chunks, support resumable hash-only intake and prove complete word/non-whitespace coverage before generation planning.

capabilities.title: Manage canonical story, pronunciation and performance truth
capabilities.description: Build and review story, pronunciation and performance bibles plus canonical entity/event truth, time-aware facts, contradiction findings, source evidence and approved append-only retcons without promoting proposals to canon automatically.

capabilities.title: Verify voice and media rights before generation
capabilities.description: Verify voice identity rights, consent, intended uses, territories and expiry before generation or release; named performers are craft references rather than cloning targets absent explicit verifiable rights.

capabilities.title: Rank and negotiate narration provider capabilities
capabilities.description: Compare project requirements with provider voice/language/media capabilities and select bounded candidate routes without making any provider a permanent architecture dependency or claiming a configured provider is reachable.

capabilities.title: Orchestrate durable narration generation
capabilities.description: Queue idempotent generation intents with exclusive worker leases, bounded retries and cancellation, write provider output to private temporary storage and require artifact verification before generation can complete.

capabilities.title: Evaluate narration candidates and continuity
capabilities.description: Evaluate transcript fidelity, engineering limits, pronunciation, performance and cross-book continuity; quarantine invalid output and admit only the exact verified candidate bundle for subsequent human/non-destructive take approval.

capabilities.title: Assemble and master approved audiobook material
capabilities.description: Assemble chapters only from approved artifacts, validate dependency closure and master against explicit delivery profiles without turning a technically valid master into automatic release approval.

capabilities.title: Plan restrained illustrated story companions
capabilities.description: Build art-directed scene/beat plans and visual continuity evidence for optional illustrated companions without producing generic sentence-by-sentence imagery or taking source-art authority from Art Studio.
requires: Art Studio handoff for production artwork

capabilities.title: Prepare evidence-bound audiobook release packages
capabilities.description: Construct governed release packages from exact verified, reviewed and rights-valid dependencies and require final confirmation separately from generation completion and take approval.

capabilities.title: Run Storyteller architecture and artifact validation
capabilities.description: Run repository verification/build and fail-closed architecture, security, artifact, queue, fidelity, rights and release-contract checks without enabling an external voice provider or publishing media.
